events.name: The Leaky Punt
rumors: Sister Ilsa wants a Moon Lotus from the drowned temple. Brave or foolish, take your pick.
The temple's guardian has four heads. Cut one off and it keeps biting with the rest.
Nagas came up out of the deep water when the temple sank. They don't like visitors.
Swamp drakes breathe a gas that rots the lungs. Bring cure potions.
Leeches in the shallows carry the marsh fever.

events.name: Jetty
events.text: Punts knock gently against the jetty. Far to the south-west, the roof of a drowned temple breaks the water.

events.name: Sister Ilsa's Hut
events.text: An old woman stirs a pot that smells of rain. "The Moon Lotus blooms only in the dark water of the Sunken Temple. Its petals can draw poison from a dying man. The thing that nests there will not let it go easily. Bring me one?"

events.name: Sister Ilsa's Hut
events.text: Ilsa cradles the pale flower. "Still cold from the deep water. Wear this, and may the marsh never claim you."

events.name: Sister Ilsa's Hut
events.text: "The lotus is steeping. Half of Duskmere will be grateful this winter."

events.name: Old Wren's Landing
events.text: Old Wren the ferryman stares into the marsh fog. "My grandfather was buried in the barrows, before the Barrow-King woke and took them. Lay that king to rest - bring me his crown, so I know it's done."

events.name: Old Wren's Landing
events.text: Wren drops the black crown into the deepest water of the marsh. "There. Now the old ones can sleep. Take this - it's all I saved."

events.name: Old Wren's Landing
events.text: Wren poles his ferry slowly through the reeds, humming.

A woman with a shaved head lets you in and bars the door. "I am Veyl. I sang with the Choir until I understood what the Bell does. They are recasting the Hollow Bell in a sunken belfry in the east of the Ashen Hills. When it rings, every voice in the six towns goes into it. The door opens only to the Belfry Key - the Archivist in Port Ashkar will know who carries it." She looks at you. "And now you know what I was. The Watch hangs Choir singers. Will you tell them?"

options.label: Keep her secret
options.text: Veyl presses two vials into your hands. "For the Belfry. You will need your voices there."

options.label: Hand her over to the Duskmere Watch
options.text: The Watch takes Veyl away in irons. Their captain pays you the bounty on Choir singers without meeting your eyes.

events.name: A Quiet Hut

events.text: Veyl whispers through the door: "Port Ashkar. The Archivist. Hurry."
events.name: A Quiet Hut

events.text: The hut is shuttered and empty. Someone has scratched a closed mouth on the door.
events.name: A Quiet Hut

events.text: A shuttered hut. Someone inside is being very, very quiet.
events.name: A Quiet Hut
